hero.subtitle: Video Production · Studio · Camera Rental
hero.desc: A full-service production house and rental base on Vietnam's central coast — film & commercial production, a 360m² studio, and cinema camera & equipment rental, under one roof.

about.desc: Six years on the Central Vietnam coast, one crew under one roof — we write it, light it, shoot it and grade it in-house. TVCs, brand films and music videos, backed by a 360m² studio and the cinema gear to pull them off. End to end, no hand-offs.

services.desc: From the first storyboard to the final color pass — or just the space and the gear when you've got the crew.

equipment.desc: Every kit is checked, cleaned and charged before it leaves the shelf. Pick up at our Sơn Trà base or add delivery.

studio.desc: Full blackout, high ceilings and a seamless cyclorama — plus a dedicated podcast & talking-head set. Grip, stands and power are already in the space. Book by the hour.

contact.desc: Tell us about the project — a shoot, a studio day, or a gear list. We reply within one business day.
